stem: Which key idea about sports is supported by the details in the section “Records”?

options.label: A
options.text: People who judge competitions are usually former athletes.

options.label: B
options.text: Modern sports include the ability to compare the performance of athletes.

options.label: C
options.text: Many athletes compete because they enjoy a particular sport.

options.label: D
options.text: Athletes train for many years in order to compete at an elite level.
